body: If the ID number below is 99 at most, shouldn't the length check be 253 characters instead (since `99` is 2 characters)?

Ah, that's correct! I took this code directly without any changes from [platform/linuxbsd/os_linuxbsd.cpp](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/platform/linuxbsd/os_linuxbsd.cpp#L1081-L1087). Will update it accordingly, thanks for pointing that out..

Is there any significance to this path? Does the user have a way to restore files from the trash?

Given that the editor uses `move_to_trash()`, I think we should implement this. But if there isn't actually a trash that the user can access and restore files from, maybe this method should just permanently delete files?
